Glad you got it working. I've saved this as a project memory: newer wkhtmltopdf versions need `--enable-local-file-access`, or the invoice PDF tests fail. The next time someone sees those failures on a new machine or after an upgrade, it should come up right away.

The repo had no uncommitted changes when we started, so your fix may only exist on your machine, for example in a local config or wrapper. If so, it's worth committing it to wherever the project calls wkhtmltopdf so CI and other developers don't hit the same failure.
